skills.name: Listen Up (听咱一言/話を聞いてくれ)
skills.description: Hoshiguma Douji attack a single target with his harsh words, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK. If the target is inflicted with Confuse after the attack, he has a 40% chance of making them launch a normal attack.

upgrades.text: Chance of launching a normal attack increases to 50%.
Chance of launching a normal attack increases to 60%.
Chance of launching a normal attack increases to 80%.
Chance of launching a normal attack increases to 100%.

skills.name: Spare the Innocent (刀下留人/ちょっと待った)
skills.description:
Hoshiguma Douji gains immunity to confusion.
When receiving a normal attack, and if he is not immobile, he has a 25% chance to Dodge the attack and command the Wine Demon in his bowl to inflict the attacker with Confuse, lasts for 1 turn.
When Confuse wears off on an enemy, Hoshiguma Douji's move bar is increased by 10%. If Confuse is dispelled, his move bar is increased by 20% instead. ;Dodge :Grants immunity to all damage from normal attacks, including normal attacks from Assist or Call to Arms. Also grants immunity to any debuffs or control effects inflicted with normal attacks.

skills.name: The Enemy is There! (敌在酒碗处/敵は酒の杯にある！)
skills.description:
Hoshiguma Douji throws his wine bowl at an enemy, inflicting them with 5 layers of Accused, lasts until the end of battle or until or all layers are lost. Then, he has a 25% base chance to inflict all enemies with Confuse, lasts for 1 turn.
The next Listen Up he uses will have an additional effect: also has a 40% base chance to inflict Confuse on the target, lasts for 1 turn. ; : ;Accused (攻撃の的) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': Increases the damage received from normal attacks by 20%, and becomes a priority target for anyone with Confuse.
When receiving a normal attack, 1 layer of Accused is lost. Only 1 layer can be lost for each action taken.

upgrades.text: Base chance to inflict Confuse increases to 28%.
Base chance to inflict Confuse increases to 32%.
Base chance to inflict Confuse increases to 36%.
Base chance to inflict Confuse increases to 40%.

bio.condition: Team Hoshiguma Douji with another player's Shuten Douji and clear any zone 10 times.
In PVP, Practice or Spar, trigger one of Hoshiguma Douji's Wine Demon stickers.
